start: Workout open on the phone with watch logging; next set Bench Press 62.5 kg × 8

user_sees: Next-set screen: the name, "Set 2 of 4", pills "62.5" and "8", and the first time "Tap a number, then turn the dial"
must_not: Pills with "—" when the phone sent numbers

steps.action: Tap the reps pill and turn the dial two steps
user_sees: Reps 10, one light tick per step
"How hard was it?" "6 easy · 10 max" when the phone asks for effort, else the set goes at once
The rest timer starts on the watch at once
"Saved" for about 2 seconds when the phone confirms
must_not: No rest because the phone was slow

user_sees: The reps change at once (the dial works with nothing tapped)
must_not: The screen's first dial turn after waking from dim changing a number

user_sees: The set goes with the new reps

start: Next-set screen; the phone is out of range (or cannot read the set)

user_sees: The rest still starts on the watch
"Not saved" with "Log this set on your phone" and OK (within 10 seconds when the phone says nothing)
must_not: "Saved" for a set the phone never got

steps.action: Clear the reps so no number is in the box, then tap Done
user_sees: unknown: Done does nothing when reps are needed and empty; no word is shown (seen in code)
must_not: An empty set sent to the phone

start: Last set of an exercise on the next-set screen

must_not: Two sets saved on the phone

steps.action: Wait for the rest to end
user_sees: "Rest is over" about 5 seconds, then the exercise-done screen, then the next exercise
must_not: A blank screen after "Rest is over"
